rows.grounds: present passive participle describing one subjected to cutting
optative passive expressing potential or actual effect negated
compound indicating one who has attained that state
bahuvrihi compound indicating one whose mind is absorbed in that

items.question: Does absorption in that state prevent harm when the body is being cut?
premises: A person may be subjected to the act of being cut.
One who has gone to that state has the mind fixed on that.
Such mental absorption negates the effect of being cut.
items.inference: One absorbed in that state remains unharmed even while being cut.
uncertainties: The exact referent of 'that' (tad) depends on the preceding context.
items.plain_english: Though being cut, one who has gone to that and whose mind is fixed on that is not cut.
